26389.description:
Content & Social Media Coordinator
Location: Port Moresby
PNG Motors is one of Papua New Guinea’s most recognised automotive groups, representing Ford, Mazda, Hyundai, Suzuki, JMC and Joylong. Our vehicles are everywhere — now we need someone who can help tell those stories properly, in a way that feels real, local, and worth watching.
The Job (Straight Talk)
You’ll help manage and create the content that keeps PNG Motors active online. That means creating posts, reels, videos, captions, and stories that people actually stop for — not content that gets scrolled past. You’ll be out in dealerships, at launches, on the road, and sometimes in the sun getting the shot because that’s where the good content happens.
You’ll support the day-to-day running of our social media channels, help respond to comments and messages, and keep things active, fresh, and on-brand. You’ll work closely with the marketing and sales teams to support promotions and launches, and sometimes you’ll need to move quickly when something is happening now, not next week.
This role is hands-on. You’ll be filming, editing, writing captions, and posting content yourself. If you enjoy being creative and getting things done, you’ll enjoy this role.
Who You Are
You’re creative, switched on, and comfortable using a camera or phone to capture good content. You know the basics of shooting and editing for social media and understand what works on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok in PNG.
You understand PNG humour and culture. You know when to keep things fun, when to keep them sharp, and when to keep them respectful. You’re organised enough to plan content but flexible enough to adjust when something better comes along.
Most importantly, you’re someone who enjoys creating and sharing stories that people actually want to watch.
Why PNG Motors
You’ll work with well-known vehicle brands and have access to great content opportunities — vehicles, people, events, and real stories happening across the country. You’ll have the chance to be creative, try new ideas, and build a strong portfolio of work.
The job is fast-paced, sometimes unpredictable, but never boring.
Apply Now
If you enjoy creating content, understand social media, and want a role where your work is seen every day, we want to hear from you.
Send your CV, a short cover note, and examples of your work or social pages to
[email protected]
Applications close: 16 March 2026
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Apply

26118.description:
GENERATOR SPECIALIST-LAE BASE
International Food Corporation ltd, the leading manufacture of Besta Mackerel and Tuna products in PNG and South Pacific seeking to recruit highly motivated and qualified experience individual to fill the position of
Generator Specialist.
OVERALL RESPONSIBILITY:
The responsibilities of Generator specailist are to ensure the safe installation and operation of electricity generators on location to manage, balance load, distribution of power to equipment as required, ensuring that electrical circuits do not become overloaded and continue power supplies to all area without interruptions.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Conduct pre-start up checks ensuring all parameters and requirements are met for safe and efficient operation of the generator,
Start or stop generators, auxiliary equipment, and other power plant equipment and connect or disconnect equipment from circuits,
Adjust generator output controls to match the phase, frequency and voltage of electricity supplied to specified plants and control panels,
Monitor, inspect and report for generator and associated auxiliary components and indicators to detect evidence of operating problems,
Take readings from meters, gauges and charts to establish intervals and take necessary steps as necessary,
Collect oil, water or electrolyte samples for analysis as required,
Examine and perform the report for test power distribution,
Inspect records and log book entries and communicate with superiors to assess operating status,
Attend to calls, call in necessary personnel during outage and emergencies,
Record and compile operational data, logs and reports,
Perform routine health check, maintenance on equipment and determine types of major maintenances needed,
Inform/Report immediately any abnormality to the superior,
Perform the genset activity plan schedule to superior,
Conduct the preventive/predictive for the parts/lubricant replacement, services and overhauling,
Inspect and perform the parts, equipment and tools inventory.
Evaluate, identify and do the parts ordering to replenish the inventory.
Inspect safety devices on daily basis by running tests and reporting any unusual situations/abnormality,
Conduct regular improvement plan,
Maintain the regular communication with the superior,
Execute daily and weekly cleaning/5S procedures, e.g. clean, dry, organize, bright/shine paint, sort, shining clean floor walls ceiling, functioning electrical appliances, shut close align panel, zero dust and tidy surroundings.
SKILLS
3-5 years of related experience.
Certified Internal Combustion Engines.
Inspect generator engine and mechanical/electrical components to diagnose issues accurately.
Knowledge of 12-24 VDC electrical systems and procedures, methods and techniques to design, install, repair and maintain generators, by-pass pumps, starters, pumps, valves, motors and gauges.
Knowledge of diesel, gasoline, propane driven internal combustion engines.
Knowledge of laws and regulations governing the operation of equipment and materials.
Knowledge of occupational hazards, safety precautions, and safety regulations related to equipment operation, hazardous materials and other work-related precautions.
Provide accurate estimates (cost, time, effort) for a repair or maintenance job
Keep logs on work and issues.
Ability to work independently and make routine decisions on the operation of the plant processes and equipment.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and effectively.
Knowledge of AC/DC power systems.
REQUIREMENTS
Minimum grade 12 level / High school diploma.
Electrical qualification.
Have a working knowledge of basic machinery preventive maintenance and repair.
Electrical exposure/understanding.
Ability to work independently and make routine decisions on the operation of the plant processes and equipment.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and effectively.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Experience in quality control within a manufacturing environment, preferably in metal packaging or 2-piece can production.

25860.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Reporting to the Coordinator – Paste Reticulation, this role will be required to ensure the installation of underground paste reticulation and infrastructure is carried out in a safe and efficient manner and in accordance with K92 Mining site requirements and procedures. Paste Crew personnel are also tasked with assisting paste filling operations in the function of conducting routine checks and responding to potential issues that may arise while backfilling.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Operate and maintain underground mobile plant including light vehicles, Volvo L120 IT and Normet scissor lift.
Perform prestart and troubleshooting of fleet and tooling to identify and remedy issues that may arise.
Install Paste Reticulation and associated infrastructure, including Quattro diverter valves.
Operate airleg rock drills while working at heights.
Pre-start inspections of paste filling reticulation lines and exclusion zones.
Respond in a timely manner to any paste blockage events according to response plans.
Respond to routine and emergency calls for repair, service and/or support as required to ensure downtime on plant and equipment is minimised.
Support and assist the Coordinator – Paste Reticulation to ensure the rectification of identified clashes in planned paste reticulation areas.
Work closely with the Senior Specialist – Paste Operations to ensure that all installation QA/QC processes and routine condition monitoring are implemented to maximise results and reduce risk of unplanned downtime.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
Ensure equipment maintenance is conducted by competent technicians in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures.
About You
It is requirement of the position that the incumbent possess the following.
Experience underground or in a similar role
Tickets in LV, IT, scissor lift & handheld rock drill tools
Ability to work in a fast-paced, physically demanding environment
Ability to work autonomously with limited supervision
Demonstrate abilities to work within a team environment to achieve a common objective
Knowledge of paste backfilling systems
General knowledge of underground equipment
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

“Join our team to create communications materials, supporting public diplomacy events, and collaborating to provide effective communications across all APEP workstreams.”
Program Title:
Australia-Papua New Guinea Economic Partnership (APEP)
Position Title:
Communications Coordinator
Position Type:
Long-term Personnel
Level:
4
Reporting To:
Communications Adviser
Location:
Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea (regional travel as required)
*Abt is committed to advancing women’s leadership in PNG’s economic development and are building an environment where women can lead progress and shape economic outcomes. Abt promotes an inclusive, respectful and safe working environment for
women and encourages PNG women and men to apply.
This position includes health insurance and supportive workplace for parents and carers, including relevant leave and other benefits including shuttle services to and from work.
Program Overview:
The
Australia–Papua New Guinea Economic Partnership (APEP)
is a flagship partnership supporting Papua New Guinea’s economic development priorities. Delivered by the Government of Australia in close collaboration with the Government of Papua New Guinea, APEP focuses on strengthening economic systems, institutions, and opportunities that support sustainable and inclusive growth through to 2028.
Working alongside government, research institutions, and development partners, APEP delivers coordinated and high‑impact outcomes across four key engagement areas:
Safeguarding Macroeconomic Stability
Supporting More Efficient and Inclusive Markets
Fostering Inclusive Growth and Expanded Livelihoods
Catalysing Economic Research and Dialogue
Gender equality, disability social inclusion (GEDSI), women’s economic empowerment, and climate are central to APEP and integrated across all engagement areas and activities.
Position Overview:
The position is responsible for developing a range of communications products and supporting the delivery of public diplomacy (PD) events.  The role will require a high level of expertise and skills in writing for external audiences and stakeholders, as well as photography skills.  The role will report to the Communications Adviser and work closely with all members of the communications team to deliver effective communications support across all the APEP workstreams.
Specific Responsibilities:
Prepare high-quality content for a variety of communication formats, including media releases, reports, talking points, and social media content including short videos.
Ensure that all written content is consistent with DFAT’s style guide and branding protocols.
Plan and develop communications products which promote the impact of APEP’s support.
Attend events and forums as required to capture content for communications products.
Engage closely with all APEP workstreams to proactively monitor upcoming events and PD opportunities.
Develop creative communication materials for a range of projects, such as events, campaigns and launches.
Work closely with the communications team to create innovative and impactful communications products.
Engage with the DFAT Communications and PD team as required – this may include attending contractor meetings and forums.
Manage the partnership brand in line with DFAT guidelines.
Develop and deliver communications training to APEP team members as required.
Contribute to reporting, administration, data collection and other tasks as directed by the Communications Adviser
Implement relevant components of the APEP GEDSI strategy into all communications products.
Any other reasonable duties as required.
Selection Criteria:
For applications to be considered,
a response to the Selection Criteria below should be provided
.
A degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related area is preferred.
A minimum of 3-5 years of professional experience in communications and marketing, ideally within a development context.
Demonstrated strong verbal and written communication skills through extensive experience in writing and editing for a variety of media platforms and diverse audiences.
Demonstrated capability to offer technical communications guidance and assistance to APEP teams.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and Mailchimp.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and effectively as a member of a team
Consistently demonstrated dedication to GEDSI, climate considerations, and safeguarding as integral cross-cutting priorities for APEP.
“We value capability and potential, and welcome applicants who believe they can succeed in this role. If you consider yourself qualified for the position, by meeting most selection criteria, you’re encouraged to apply.”
How to Apply
Please ensure to address the Selection Criteria (About You) in your cover letter, and submit your application online, along with your CV as a single document.
Applications must be submitted personally by individuals only. Applications submitted by a company or organisation will not be accepted.
The successful applicant will be engaged through an employment agreement determined by Abt.
We welcome and thank all applications; however, only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
Closing Date: Sunday, 15 March 2026 (Midday, local time) #LI-AUSBRIT
Abt Global is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to upholding high standards of Child
Protection, Anti-bribery and Fraud Protection.
We encourage applications from experienced and capable women, and people with disabilities
Apply

CONTEXT
Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) is a private, non-profit international humanitarian organization, founded in 1971 and working in 70 countries around the world. MSF provides medical assistance to populations in crisis, regardless of race, religion, belief or political affiliation. In PNG, MSF has been working since 2007 in Lae, Taric, Bougainville, Gulf Province and NCD Province. MSF is now working to support the Department of Health to improve access to care for patients in Lae, Jiwaka and Highlands.

Checking daily, the technical conditions of the assigned vehicle (state of the tires, oil, fuel, brakes, radio equipment, spare parts, vehicle body etc.), performing weekly check according to the MSF Logbook, refilling it when necessary, and keeping it clean to ensure it can be driven in perfect conditions.
Carrying out a proper handover of the vehicle from one driver to another during shift/ driver change.
Ensuring the security of passengers in the vehicle, driving carefully, observing speed limits and traffic rules in the country as well as MSF security rules, in order to avoid car accidents.
Ensuring all passengers have all necessary paperwork in order before travelling and ensuring non-MSF staff sign discharge of liability before using the vehicle.
Ensuring that all vehicle documents and the driver's driving license are valid, up to date and stored the vehicle.
Informing the line manager of any incident involving the transportation of passengers and/or goods.
Knowing how to use all types of radios, codes, call numbers and radio alphabets by heart and communicating with base according to MSF communications policy to inform the driver's position and any potential implications.
Knowing and respecting the security rules related to vehicle movements, specifically those related to customs, checkpoints and roadblocks. Ensuring all passengers know and respect the security rules.
Good knowledge of roads in Morobe and its environs.
Ensure comprehensive handover is conducted between drivers during shift/ driver change.
Renewal of your driver’s licence before its expiration.

Proper recording of fuel dispensed into vehicle in the vehicle’s fuel log book.
Respect of defined MSF speed limits.
Ensure vehicle doors are locked when passengers enter the vehicle and seat belts worn by all passengers before driving.

Adhereance to operational instructions and responsibilities given by the Logisitcs Supervisor/ Manager.

26317.description:
Senior Marine Finance Officer
The Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) is an international non-governmental organisation committed to working with communities, government, and other partners to manage wildlife and wild places for biodiversity and human well-being. WCS PNG is recruiting a
Senior Marine Finance Officer
based in Kavieng, New Ireland Province and may be expected to travel within PNG, especially to WCS marine field sites. The position will report to the Kavieng Program Manager with a dotted line to the Finance Manager.
Role Dimension
The Senior Marine Finance Officer is responsible for managing the financial systems and administrative functions of the Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) Kavieng office. The role ensures full compliance with WCS policies, donor requirements, and applicable local regulations, while supporting efficient, transparent, and accountable financial operations. The position also provides financial oversight and administrative support to the Kimbe and Manus offices, working closely with program and finance teams to ensure strong financial management and consistency across all locations.
KEY SELECTION CRITERIA
Financial Management & Oversight
Lead financial management and administrative functions for the Kavieng office and field operations.
Provide financial oversight and technical support to Kimbe and Manus offices.
Ensure compliance with WCS policies, donor requirements, legal agreements, and local laws.
Maintain high standards of financial accountability, transparency, and operational efficiency.
Banking and Cash Management
Monitor and control WCS-PNG Marine office cash positions, including daily bank monitoring and reconciliations.
Ensure adequate cash balances are maintained to support operational needs; notify the Finance Director of funding requirements.
Manage cash flow across WCS-PNG Marine bank accounts and facilitate inter-account transfers as needed.
Liaise with program teams to forecast cash needs and support timely monthly cash requests.
Process and reconcile banking transactions, petty cash, staff advances, and acquittals.
Verify supporting documentation for all bank and cash transactions.
Review weekly accounting records prior to submission to the Finance Director.
Perform monthly balance sheet reconciliations (payables, receivables, advances, bank, petty cash, and prepayments).
Monitor bank balances to ensure uninterrupted Marine field operations.
Petty Cash Management
Process petty cash advances and expenses daily in compliance with WCS and donor requirements.
Prepare journal vouchers and post petty cash transactions in SAP with correct coding.
Conduct daily petty cash reconciliations and month-end cash counts.
Maintain an imprest petty cash system with monthly reviews and approvals by the Program Manager.
Employee Advances and Expense Management
Process employee advances and expense claims in line with WCS and donor policies.
Review and reconcile employee acquittals, including necessary bank lodgments.
Prepare journal entries for advances and acquittals for month-end reporting.
Maintain monthly employee advance balance reports.
Ensure complete and organized documentation filing.
Provide guidance and training to program staff on financial procedures and timelines when required.
Processing of Local Expenses
Review and process non-employee program expenses in compliance with donor and procurement requirements, ensuring:
Proper procurement procedures are followed
Appropriate approvals and signatures are obtained
Accuracy of amounts and purchase requisitions
Correct financial coding
Process payments through online banking or petty cash as appropriate.
Prepare journal entries for expense postings in SAP.
Track expenditures against approved budgets and Allocate expenses accurately to donor-funded projects.
Reporting & Coordination
Prepare and submit financial reports to the Senior Finance Coordinator in Goroka.
Respond promptly to finance-related queries.
Support program managers with financial planning and budget monitoring.
Coordinate financial processes for major and complementary projects.
Administrative & Asset Management
Process office bills and authorized expenditures in a timely manner.
Maintain and update asset registers and support proper care and tracking of equipment.
Reconcile travel advances and reimbursements promptly.
Maintain organized filing systems for financial and personnel records.
Update staff leave databases and manage induction and exit documentation.
Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.
Minimum Requirements:
Education/Credentials
A degree in accounting / Business Administration or qualification from a recognized professional accounting body (CA/ACCA/CPA)
Experience
Requires a minimum of 3 years accounting and administrative management experience
Exposure to non-profit sector (NGO, International organisations) is an added advantage
Critical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Good analytical and problem solving skills
Preferably familiar with requirements of different donors.
Good knowledge of accounting system.
Competent in the use of Microsoft Office such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint etc.
Require knowledge of financial systems, internal controls and procedures
Able to work and interact with diverse group of people
Experience in the most current technologies and products used in the industry.
Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence
Being a self-starter with drives and initiative and able to work as a team/individual with a positive attitude and open minded
Ability to work with less supervision and under pressure
Excellent multi-tasking, organized and follow-up skills,
Demonstrated work experience providing customer service.
Application process
Please send a CV and letter of interest to
[email protected]
with the subject line: Application for Kavieng Senior Marine Finance Officer. Applications accepted until
Friday 13 March 2026
. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted for interviews.

26292.description:
Contracts Administrator
Simberi Gold Company Limited forms part of the St Barbara Group. Our Simberi Operations consists of an open cut mine on the northernmost island in the Tabar group of islands in the province of New Ireland in Papua New Guinea. Our vision is to grow sustainably and create enduring, positive impacts for the people and communities touched by our operations.
Now is an exciting time for our business and for our people. We’re going through a period of significant change and are gaining momentum in transforming our business. We’re looking for people who are ready to grow through opportunity and build a bright future with us.​​
We are currently seeking a
Contracts Administrator
to join our team. This is a permanent full-time position for our Simberi Operation. Your work location is Papua New Guinea, this is a 21/14 Roster.
The position will initially be based on site at Simberi, however in the future will be based in Port Moresby.
Reporting to the Contracts & Procurement Superintendent, the Contracts Administrator is responsible for developing, administering and evaluating international, national and local landowner Contracts. They will ensure that all parties understand the terms of the contract, while complying relevant Papua New Guinean laws. This role will provide support to the Contract Specialist and liaise as required with the Community Relations Business Development Officer in relation to Local and Landowner Contracts and new business opportunities.
Everyone at St Barbara Limited is required to understand and act in accordance with St Barbara’s Values, Code of Conduct and all Company Policies and meet all relevant internal and external compliance obligations.
The opportunity
Role accountabilities
Ensuring own Health & Safety as well as that of all other workers, identifying and maintaining safe work practices and completing all required safety training.
Prepare tender documentation and administer tender process, through to contract awarding and execution stage.

The Organisation:
Pacific Adventist University (PAU) is owned and operated by the South Pacific Division of the Seventh-day Adventist Church. The institution is accredited to the Adventist Accreditation Association, an international denominational authority for all tertiary and graduate educational programs and institutions owned by the Seventh-day Adventist Church entities. The main campus is located on the pristine Koiari Park, 14 miles outside Port Moresby, the capital of Papua New Guinea. The institution was established in 1984. Since then, it has grown from a college of 20 students to a university of over 1000 students from across the Pacific.

The role involves teaching, supervising postgraduate students, conducting high-quality research, and supporting the development of institutional research capacity.

26279.description:
Credit Corporation Properties Limited seeks an experienced person to fill in the role of Maintenance On-Call Officer.
The Maintenance On-call Officer provides after-hours support and emergency maintenance response for residential properties within the company’s portfolio. The role ensures tenant safety, protects company assets, and maintenance continuity of essential services in apartments and staff. This role is based in Port Moresby.
Primary Responsibilities:
A. Emergency Response (Residential Focused)
Respond immediately to tenant emergency calls (e.g., power outages, broken locks, water leaks, flooding, faulty air‑conditioning).
Prioritize tenant safety during incidents involving fire alarms, gas leaks, smoke, or security-related issues.
Secure units during emergencies (e.g., damaged doors or windows).
B. General Residential Maintenance
Perform minor and temporary repairs such as:
-Fixing leaks or burst pipes
-Restoring tripped breakers or power faults
-Replacing blown light bulbs or damaged fittings
-Temporary AC fault stabilization
-Clearing blocked drains or toilets
Provide temporary solutions until daytime technical teams conduct full repairs.
C. Residential Property Inspections:
Conduct checks on:
-Common areas (corridors, lighting, stairwells, parking areas)
-Water pumps, pressure systems, and tanks
-Perimeter lighting and security gates
-Smoke detectors and fire safety equipment
Identify hazards that could impact residents
D. Tenant Support & Communication:
Communicate effectively and professionally with residents, ensuring issues are understood and prioritized.
Explain temporary fixes or the next steps if a specialist is required.
Escalate issues to the Facilities Manager or contractors when urgent intervention is needed.
E. Coordination
Work together with:
-Security teams (access, safety, lockouts)
-Contractors (plumbing/electrical emergencies)
-Property officers/managers
Assist in escorting contractors for after-hours work, ensuring safety protocols.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain an after-hours incident log including:
-Time of call
-Nature of issue
-Action taken
-Pending tasks
Provide daily reports for supervisor follow-up.
G. Safety & Compliance
Follow residential safety and access protocols, including secure handling of master keys.
Uphold tenant privacy and confidentiality.
Comply with building codes and HSE standards for residential spaces.
Qualifications & Experience:
Required
Trade qualification in maintenance, plumbing, electrical, or building services.
Minimum 2 years’ experience in residential or facilities maintenance.
Ability to diagnose and resolve common residential issues.
Strong communication skills and good attitude.
Driver's license (Class 3 or 6)
Preferred,
Experience in apartments, townhouses, or staff accommodation facilities.
Knowledge of residential electrical systems, water services, and HVAC basics.
Familiarity with PNG residential maintenance challenges (e.g., water pressure issues, tropical climate impacts).
Key Competencies:
Strong customer service mindset (tenant-centred)
Fast and effective problem-solving
Reliability and responsiveness
Ability to work independently at night
Awareness of safety and security risks in residential settings
Good record‑keeping and accountability

CORPORATE TRAINING COORDINATOR
The Corporate Training, Safety & Quality Risk Department is seeking for an experienced candidate for the position of Corporate Training Coordinator based in Port Moresby, functionally reporting to Manager Corporate Training.
This role is responsible for planning, organizing, conducting, and managing all training programs for airline staff, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and aligning with the airline's operational standards. This role encompasses training for pilots, flight attendants, engineers, ground crew, and other personnel as necessary to meet business demands. The Coordinator plays a crucial role in the Safety and Quality Action Group, contributing to the enhancement of safety protocols and operational efficiency through effective training initiatives.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Coordinate and develop (when required) training programs for various airline personnel including pilots, flight attendants, engineers, and ground crew.
Ensure training programs comply with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
Continuously review and update training materials to reflect changes in regulations, procedures, and technology in consultation with the GMSASR.
Coordinate logistics for training sessions, including scheduling, venue arrangement, and resource allocation.
Maintain accurate records of training activities, participant progress, and certification status.

Utilize a variety of instructional techniques and multimedia tools (e-learning) to enhance training effectiveness.
Collaborate with the Safety and Quality Action Group to identify training needs related to safety protocols and quality assurance measures.
Implement corrective actions and training initiatives to address safety incidents or quality deficiencies.
Evaluate training effectiveness through feedback mechanisms, assessments, and performance metrics. Prepare a training evaluation summary to be submitted to the GMSASR within three days of training completion.
Provide constructive feedback to participants and stakeholders to support continuous improvement.
Ensure all training programs adhere to relevant aviation regulations, company policies, and procedures.
Maintain awareness of regulatory changes and industry trends to adapt training programs accordingly.
Work closely with departmental managers and subject matter experts to develop specialized training modules as per project requirements.
Foster a collaborative training culture that promotes teamwork, accountability, and professionalism to ensure the
safe, reliable, and on time air travel
services aligned with PNG Air's Vision and Mission.
Maintain accuracy and ensure all training records are up-to-date within 5 business days of completion and to provide the GMSASR a fortnightly training report.
Successful delivery of projects within agreed timelines.

Human Factors/CRM for Cabin Crews and Pilots approvals

Any other approval required to meet business demands
Carry out other duties or tasks as required by the GMSASR

As the Airline of Choice, we're committed to delivering a world-class experience with competitive fares, unparalleled cargo rates, and a focus on safety and on-time performance for our valued customers and stakeholders.
Properties & Facilities Building Manager
We are pleased to announce an open vacancy now exists in our Facilities & Ground Services Department for a qualified and experienced Properties & Facilities Building Manager.
Based in Port Moresby this position will report to the General Manager Operations. This role is responsible for the management of all company support facilities such as properties and vehicles.
The Properties, Facilities & Building Manager will be responsible for the following key responsibilities:
Managing the overall maintenance of all company buildings (including outports) in carpentry/plumbing/electrical related responsibilities on a day to day basis
Responsible for upgrades associated with PNG Air properties and those leased from NAC
Responsible for the regular company pest control
Including any other related duties
Managing the light repair vehicle workshop
Managing the workforce (Mechanics)
Managing all vehicle safety registrations
Responsible for providing recommendations for replacement of agent fleets where required.
Including any other related duties
To be considered, you must have the relevant qualifications with previous experience in a similar role including having the following key attributes:
Tertiary qualifications in a Business related field or in Architectural Studies
Experiences in Construction and Building Maintenance
The ability to provide advice to senior management team and the concerned key personnel on matters relating to fuel operations, facilities, transport and landside security and driving required changes.
General Airline experience with thorough knowledge in airline commercial/private operations
Has sound understanding of the development of budgets and the critical elements of a budget
Know CASA regulations
If you feel you meet our requirements and are interested, we would like to hear from you. Send your application in only one PDF file to:
[email protected]

26313.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our maintenance team on site, in this role you will be responsible for the distribution of tools and equipment to support the plant technicians / tradesman. You will also ensure the workplace health & safety of employees, Contractors and other stakeholders are maintained.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensuring that the sections daily work plans are executed as directed.
Ensure the accurate identification and labelling of stock items.
Ensure that goods requiring special handling or storage risk are handled as per safety policy and requirements.
Maintain clean and efficient warehouse premises and a properly maintained clean yard by applying “clean as you go” on all tasks undertaken.
To identify hazards and maintain a safe working environment while using 3W process.
Fully responsible for the quality of work.
Stock and direct charge items store within the designated area, that they stored in the correct location and at the right time.
Carry out regular stock maintenance and housekeeping tasks.
Ensure all tools and equipment are followed up on including the return of issued tooling.
5S to be maintained with the tooling storage areas.
Maintain safety work standards in accordance with government regulations and company policy.
Perform all roles and responsibilities that support and reflect the company’s mission and core values.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have all or some of the following
Minimum Grade ten certificate or PETT courses.
Must have good attention to detail.
Must be Computer literacy with competence in MS excel with exposure to Pronto or equivalent.
Must be able to effectively read and write in English.
Able to work with minimum supervision.
Oral and communication skills in English is desirable.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

26275.description:
About Newmont
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your Impact
You will drive local procurement initiatives that make a real impact on operational excellence and sustainable outcomes. You will lead key procurement projects, craft market documentation, evaluate bids, and build strong relationships with suppliers to deliver efficient, compliant, and high-value results. Your work will shape supplier development, strengthen community engagement, and enhance operational performance across the site.
As part of our team, you will
Lead and support PNG and Lihirian procurement activities, including running RFPs, negotiating with suppliers, and managing commercial disputes.
Support site stakeholders and the Category Management teams to identify and develop local procurement opportunities.
Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and company policies, including health, safety, environmental, ESG, and community engagement standards.
Build supplier capability through coaching, advisory documents, and ongoing support.
Contribute to the Local Procurement Plan and reporting, providing insights to improve processes and outcomes.
Present procurement outcomes to managers and other stakeholders, fostering collaboration and transparency.
Prerequisites for your success in this role
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Procurement, or related field is desirable.
Proven experience in procurement and supplier capacity building, ideally in a mining environment.
Skilled in supplier negotiations, both to achieve great contract value and resolving contract related disputes
Competence in SAP, Fieldglass and Ariba is desirable.
Excellent communication, negotiation, public speaking, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong cultural awareness, particularly in engaging with Lihirian communities and local businesses.
Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with a focus on building long-term relationships and delivering value.
Ability to work independently as a motivated self-starter while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Your work environment
This role is offered on a 21:21 Fly in, Fly out (FIFO) roster to Lihir Island, Papua New Guinea.
Our FIFO employees stay in a secure and comfortable camp, in an en-suited and airconditioned room equipped with mini fridge, TV and Wi-Fi. A variety of healthy meal options are catered for at our mess; and the wet mess provides a relaxed social setting where employees can unwind with a game of pool or darts.
You will engage with internal stakeholders including team leads, superintendents, and category management teams, as well as external stakeholders such as local suppliers and government officials. You will operate in a dynamic, collaborative environment, leading procurement activities that are critical to site performance and community impact.
Why Join Newmont
At Newmont, you will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on site operations while developing your career in a global mining environment. You will work with a team that values collaboration, innovation, and cultural awareness, and you will contribute to sustainable, ethical procurement practices that support local communities and operational excellence.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!
Submit your application through our website quoting reference number 40308 before the advertised closing date: 12 March 2026.
Apply

Summer Institute of Linguistics Papua New Guinea (SIL-PNG) has an exciting opportunity for highly motivated professionals, including recent graduates, to join our dynamic team in Ukarumpa, Kainantu. We are seeking individuals with a
servant heart
who are looking for a challenge and change of scenery. This vital role supports the work of Bible Translation.
PURPOSE OF THE JOB
The Education Media Production Assistant primary purpose is to support SIL PNG language teams and LE staff in the production, distribution, and archiving of vernacular educational materials across various media formats (print, digital, audio/visual). This position reports to the Director of Language Program Services and the EFL Media Trainer.
Key Responsibilities:
Learn and apply principles of print and digital book creation, layout, and publication.
Master relevant software (e.g., Publisher, Bloom, ActivePresenter, Reading App Builder) for production and training purposes.
Acquire knowledge of intellectual property (IP) issues to educate others.
Provide production support for vernacular literacy materials, utilizing strong cross-cultural communication skills.

Perform other duties as directed by your supervisor or management.

Diploma in Primary Teaching
Fluent in English & Tok Pisin (Speaking, Listening, Reading, Writing)
Strong computer literacy, proficiency in Microsoft office and general office software, including effective file management and email applications.
Proficient touch typing skills.
Experience with desktop publishing is preferred.
Strong interpersonal skills for effective cross- cultural verbal and written communication
PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
Commitment to SIL PNG Goals
Flexible, adaptable and able to cope with unforeseen circumstances
Willingness to serve and ability to relate well with ex-pats and nationals
Honest and reliable with a personal commitment to upholding Christian values
Patient and with a good temperament

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong project management skills.

26227.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our exploration team, in this role you will operate LM90 Diamond Drill rigs and recover an accurate sample/core as per K92 mining specification, in a safe, cost-effective and timely manner.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Management of the diamond drill tooling, inventory and all related machinery and equipment.
Diagnose down hole problems and remedy issues that may arise.
Ensure survey data is being recorded and reported correctly and in a timely manner.
Ensure diamond drill core recovery is maximised and displayed correctly.
Ensure record keeping is completed correctly and in a timely manner for drill reports, consumables and any other requirements as identified.
Ensure effective processes for communicating relevant information, including company, site, department, and team performance, to all team members are in place.
Direct and train employees on appropriate and effective drill practices and techniques.
Develop team members through regular feedback, coaching and formal training.
Identify skills gaps and training requirements and assist in developing training packages as required to close the skills gap.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
Ensure diamond drilling operations are conducted by competent operators in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures and legislation.
About You
To be considered for this position, it is essential that applicants have demonstrated experience in the safe operation of an LM90 Diamond Drill rig. In addition to this, applicants should also
Qualifications in Drilling Operations or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 3 years experiences drilling with LM90 and rod handler.
Possess certified Miner training certificate in area of handling hand drill machine
Basic Life Support and First Aid Certificate.
PNG National Driver’s License. (Class 6 preferred)
Knowledge of critical components of the Drills and their functions.
Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent trouble shooting skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.

NextGen Technology Limited is seeking a highly skilled and proactive IT Support Officer with a strong background in domain hosting to join our team.
The ideal candidate will provide technical assistance and customer support related to domain configuration, email setup, server security, and web hosting management. This role requires experience in DNS management, WHM/cPanel environments, and troubleshooting deliverability issues. Experience with Microsoft 365 setup and basic website development are strong pluses.
Key Responsibilities:
Provide email and technical support for clients experiencing issues related to hosting, domain services, and email configuration.
Configure and manage domain name settings, including DNS records (A, MX,CNAME, TXT, etc.), registrar setup, and name servers.
Troubleshoot and resolve email delivery issues, spam problems, and perform diagnostics using tools such as mail logs, DNS lookups, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and SMTP traces.
Perform hosting-related tasks such as creating and managing hosting accounts via WHM/cPanel, backups, resource monitoring, and server optimization.
Implement and maintain server security best practices including firewall configuration, SSL installation, malware protection, and intrusion detection.
Regularly monitor servers for performance, uptime, and security vulnerabilities.

Document procedures, configurations, and resolutions for internal and client reference.
Liaise with third-party providers (registrars, cloud vendors) as needed to resolve issues efficiently.

Technical Skills:
Strong knowledge of domain registration and DNS configuration.
Experience with email protocols (IMAP, POP3, SMTP) and tools to test deliverability.
Proficiency in WHM, cPanel, and other web hosting control panels.
Understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, SSL, and general web/email security concepts.
Hands-on experience with server hardening, firewalls, and security monitoring tools.
Basic web development or website management skills (HTML/CSS, WordPress,etc.) is a plus.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, DNS setup, migration) is a plus.

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication skills for client-facing support.
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks independently.
Willingness to stay updated on hosting and domain technology trends.

26103.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
The Maintenance Planner ensures that all routine maintenance activities in the Surface Maintenance are appropriately planned so that the work can progress in a safe, environmentally responsible, efficient, cost effective and repeatable manner.
The Maintenance Planner will:
Continually monitor compliance to, and optimise preventative maintenance programs and schedules, to deliver performance targets for equipment availability and reliability.
Provide support to other Maintenance team members (Supervisors, Technicians, other Planners) for Planning/Scheduling, standard Pronto transactions and the fundamentals of Reliability Centred Maintenance (RCM).
Key / Major Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Work with workshop Supervisors to develop, implement and optimise preventive maintenance (PM) programs for Surface assets based on RCM principles.
Develop and update maintenance Safe Operating Procedures (SOPs), inspection sheets and checklists for PMs and other routine maintenance tasks.
Create and maintain Work Orders and Purchase Requisitions (materials, equipment, and services) in Pronto. Confirm that parts, specialised tools, equipment, and external labour are available prior to releasing Work Orders.
Work with Surface maintenance team to develop and implement a recertification/recalibration program for regulated and specialty tools/equipment as required.
Coordinate weekly scheduling meetings with Supervisors. Review and prioritise work to minimise impact on production. Use these forums to review and prioritise PMs, corrective work, and project work.
Develop and track maintenance key performance indicators (KPIs) to help guide maintenance management efforts and identify opportunities for improvement.
Manage a suitable Work Order backlog, normally with 2 to 4 weeks of planned work, ready to schedule and execute.
Update and maintain status of Work Orders in Pronto to ensure accurate backlog and history.
Work collaboratively with Supply/Warehouse team to ensure materials (parts), specialised equipment and contractor labour is available, when required, for all planned maintenance activities.
Create and maintain accurate bill of materials (BOM) and critical spares lists for all Plant Items. Submit applications for new stock items (ANSIs), as required, for new items, changes to min/max levels or changes of suppliers.
Develop and maintain good working relationships with external stakeholders such as suppliers and contractors.
Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly KPI reports.
Contribute to the annual maintenance budgeting process and monthly cost reviews.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have a bachelor’s degree in mechanical trade and/or Bachelor of Engineering degree (Mechanical) and must have 5 – 10 years experience in maintenance-focused industry, preferably in a mining environment In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.
Technical qualification in Maintenance Planning / Asset Management.
Formal certificate in Advanced MS Office.
Minimum of 5 years ‘experience with computer-based maintenance planning/schedule (preferably in mining).
Sound knowledge in the use of MS Office applications (MS Excel, MS Word, MS Project, MS Outlook.
Familiarity/experience with using Pronto.
Advanced MS Excel skills.
Advance MS Project skills.
Strong understanding of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM).
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination. Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP

About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our security team, you will be responsible for the security oversight and supervision of the Gold Room security by effectively employing the contract security deployed in the Gold Room and effective use of electronic surveillance systems installed in the Gold Room.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensure proper clearance checks are conducted during entry and exit of the Gold Room by K92 employees/contractors and visitors.
Monitoring entry/exit of maintenance workers in the Gold Room.
Daily inspections of the exterior and interior of the Gold Room and reporting deficiencies.
Final checks upon close up of the Gold Room to ensure manual and electronic security locking are okay.
Notify management team of any emergency inside the Gold Room.
Secure Gold Room during any emergency or unrest.
Monitoring and documenting waste removal processes in the Gold Room.
Daily inspections/ diagnostic tests on electronic security systems.
Daily checks on alarm systems in the Gold Room.
Daily checks of electronic access systems/doors.
24/7 Monitoring of Gold Room cameras mounted in and outside of the Gold Room.
Daily checks to ensure CCTV cameras are functional.
Use of CCTV cameras for confirmation and entry
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Possess current Grade 12 or above education
The incumbent shall have worked for at least 3 years or more preferably in a mining environment but must have passed out from a recognized security training institution with no criminal record.
Displays a high level of integrity
Knowledge of Gold Room Operations is required, including internal and external activities involving Gold Room operations.
Acute listening skills are required to determine the urgency of received messages
Attention to detail is necessary to maintain accurate communication records.
Training in electronic communications procedures and devices is essential.
The incumbent must possess a strong leadership and decision-making skills
Can be able to manage the safety and/or security and asset protection department in a resource organization.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.

Direct and train subordinates to install, maintain or repair electrical wiring, equipment and machines.
Respond to routine and emergency calls for repair and service within the mine site area.
Be on call in emergency situations and extreme conditions.

Ability to train maintenance personnel in all aspects of their trade – particularly in diagnosis and fault finding, quality control, thoroughness and record keeping.

Joining our underground mining team, you will report to the Shotcrete Supervisor and in this role will be required to ensure delivery of concrete mixes from the batch plant to required locations underground of the mine are carried out in a safe and efficient manner and in accordance with K92 Mining site requirements and procedures
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Operate and maintain Underground Agitator Truck according to all K92 Plan Operations & Maintenance procedures and fault reporting systems.
Perform prestart and troubleshooting on Underground Agitator Truck and associated equipment to identify and remedy issues that may arise.
Actively monitor the condition of mixed product to ensure product does not set prematurely in the mixing bowl.
Proactively engage with the Shotcrete Supervisor to provide technical advice and support to the Shotcrete Teams to ensure equipment availability and reliability targets are achieved and optimised against budget.
Respond to routine and emergency calls for repair, service and/or support within the mine site area as required to ensure downtime on equipment is minimised.

Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
Ensure equipment maintenance is conducted by competent technicians in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Possess a current Class 4 Drivers Licence that allows operation of a Underground Agitator Truck on public roads – (Essential)
Previous experience as an underground Agitator Truck Operator – (Desirable)
Commitment to safety – (Essential)
Knowledge of Underground Agitator Truck’s performance capabilities – (Essential)
Ability to work autonomously independent with limited supervision – (Essential)
Demonstrate abilities to work within a team environment – (Essential)
Knowledge of concrete additives and aggregates – (Desirable)

25808.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About Us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners of the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, with the majority of our workforce drawn from local communities. Through targeted social investment programs, K92 is committed to strengthening livelihoods, food security, and long-term socio-economic resilience in our host communities, including beyond mine closure.
About the Role
The Supervisor – Agriculture Projects coordinates and delivers the Sustainable Agriculture and Livelihoods Program
(SALP)
at the field level. The role works directly with farming households and community cooperatives to improve food security, diversify income sources, and build climate resilience through market-oriented, sustainable agriculture practices. The position supports delivery of MOA commitments and contributes to long-term livelihood sustainability for host communities, including post-mine closure outcomes.
Key Accountabilities
This role is responsible for supervising field-based agricultural delivery, supporting farmer capacity building, and ensuring SALP activities are implemented safely, effectively, and in line with SPMS standards. Key responsibilities include:
Lead Field Delivery of SALP:
Coordinate and deliver agriculture and livelihoods activities across coffee, cocoa, fresh produce, apiculture, and agroforestry programs, aligned to SALP phases and annual work plans.
Supervise & Support Extension Teams:
Supervise Agricultural Extension Officers, manage daily schedules, provide coaching, and ensure inclusive participation of women and youth in program activities.
Farmer Training & Demonstration Programs:
Plan and deliver farmer training, demonstration plots, and community workshops, supporting adoption of climate-smart and improved agricultural practices.
Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting:
Track yields, household income, participation, and environmental outcomes; maintain accurate SPMS records; and provide regular field reports to the Superintendent SALP.
Technical Agriculture Support:
Coordinate input distribution, monitor utilization and productivity, support certification pathways, and assist with processing infrastructure such as coffee wet mills, cocoa fermentry and driers,  nurseries,  bee keeping and honey processing, fresh produce post- harvest consolidation, and livestock breeding and distribution center.
Collaboration & Market Integration:
Work with Social Development, Business Development, government agencies, NGOs, and private sector partners to strengthen cooperatives, market access, and SME participation.
Commitments & Expectations Management:
Deliver agriculture-related MOA and CSDP commitments, manage community expectations, maintain grievance mechanisms, and escalate emerging risks or issues as required.
Health, Safety & Environment:
Ensure agricultural activities are implemented in accordance with company HSE requirements and promote safe, environmentally responsible field practices.
About You
To be considered for this role, candidates must have strong practical experience delivering agricultural extension programs in rural or community-based environments. In addition, you should be able to demonstrate:
Diploma or degree in Agriculture, Agronomy, Agribusiness, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years of experience in agricultural extension or rural development, ideally within Papua New Guinea.
Strong technical knowledge of coffee, cocoa, fresh produce, agroforestry, apiculture, and small livestock systems suited to PNG conditions, including climate-smart agriculture and pest and disease management.
Practical experience working with farming households and community cooperatives, with exposure to cooperative development, market integration, and value-chain initiatives.
Experience supporting organic or quality certification systems for coffee or cocoa is highly desirable.
Ability to collect, analyse, and report program data for monitoring, evaluation, and SPMS reporting, including quarterly indicator tracking.
Strong communication skills in English and Tok Pisin; local dialects are advantageous.
Must have PNG driving License - Class 6
Culturally sensitive, community-focused, and able to manage expectations in complex social environments.
Committed to ethical, transparent, and accountable program delivery aligned with K92’s values.
Life at K92
Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a strong commitment to equal opportunity, ensuring individuals can reach their full potential in a respectful and inclusive workplace.
We offer a supportive work environment, competitive remuneration, access to wellbeing and employee assistance programs, and the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to sustainable community development in Papua New Guinea.
If you share our values and are passionate about improving rural livelihoods through agriculture, we encourage you to apply via our website.

25807.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About Us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners of the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives, which include educational scholarships, agricultural support and health outreach programs, help to improve quality of life and build long-term capacity in local communities.
About the Role
The Supervisor – Community Affairs is a frontline leadership role responsible for coordinating and supervising the daily engagement activities of Community Liaison Officers (CLOs). The role ensures consistent, culturally appropriate stakeholder engagement and effective grievance management, supporting positive relationships between K92, landowners, and local communities. This position supports delivery of the Stakeholder Engagement & Issue Resolution Standard under the Social Performance Management System (SPMS).
Key Accountabilities
This role is responsible for supervising community engagement activities, managing grievances, and supporting the Superintendent in maintaining strong landowner and community relationships. Key responsibilities include:
Community Engagement Supervision:
Coordinate and oversee daily CLO activities, allocate work across villages and stakeholder groups, and ensure professional, consistent engagement across the operation.
Grievance & Issue Management:
Act as the first escalation point for unresolved grievances, ensure all issues are logged, tracked, and addressed in line with SPMS procedures, and support complex investigations as required.
Team Leadership & Development:
Coach, mentor, and support CLOs, review field reports for quality and accuracy, and assist with recruitment, onboarding, and performance feedback.
Operational Reporting & Data Quality:
Ensure accurate use of grievance registers, templates, and reporting tools; produce summaries of stakeholder feedback and emerging issues for management review.
Cross-Functional Coordination:
Work closely with Land Access, Social Development, Business Development, and GIS teams to support integrated community engagement and information sharing.
Commitments & Expectation Management:
Track delivery of engagement commitments, distinguish clearly between formal obligations and community expectations, and support transparent communication back to communities.
Mine Life Cycle Support:
Maintain effective engagement across exploration, operations, expansion activities, and closure planning to protect K92’s reputation and social licence.
About You
To be successful in this role, candidates must have strong community engagement experience and the ability to lead frontline engagement teams in culturally complex environments. You will also demonstrate:
Diploma or degree in Social Sciences, Development Studies, Anthropology, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years of experience in community engagement roles, preferably in Papua New Guinea or Melanesia.
Proven experience supervising field-based officers and managing community-facing work programs.
Strong record-keeping and data management skills, with the ability to ensure accuracy and transparency in grievance and engagement reporting.
High-level communication skills in Tok Pisin and English; local language capability is an advantage.
Demonstrated cultural sensitivity, fairness, and impartiality when working with diverse communities and stakeholders.
Strong integrity, professionalism, and accountability, with the ability to manage sensitive issues calmly and respectfully.
Alignment with K92’s values of collaboration, respect, and ethical conduct at the community interface.
Life at K92
Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a commitment to equal opportunity, striving to ensure that every individual can reach their highest potential without experiencing discrimination.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
We believe in sharing our success with our employees. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer participation in long- and short-term incentive plans. We also offer savings programs, medical assistance, as well as access to our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
If you share our values and are looking for your next career step, come join us on this exciting journey. Submit your application through our website today.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply
