Senior Program Manager – Economic Research & Dialogue
“Join our team to drive high impact economic research and policy dialogue in partnership with government, academia, and development leaders in Papua New Guinea”
Program Title:
Australia-Papua New Guinea Economic Partnership (APEP)
Position Title:
Senior Program Manager – Economic Research & Dialogue
Position Type:
Long-term Personnel
Level:
6
Reporting To:
APEP Director
Location:
Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
*Abt is committed to advancing women’s leadership in PNG’s economic development and are building an environment where women can lead progress and shape economic outcomes. Abt promotes an inclusive, respectful and safe working environment for women
This position includes a housing allowance, health insurance, and supportive workplace for parents and carers, including relevant leave and other benefits.
Port Moresby is a family post offering a vibrant mix of cultures, scenic coastal views, and welcoming local and international communities. Residents enjoy access to modern amenities including quality restaurants, supermarkets, hotels, and wildlife park, as well as outdoor activities including hiking, sailing, fishing and more.
Program Overview:
The Australia–Papua New Guinea Economic Partnership (APEP) is a flagship partnership supporting Papua New Guinea’s economic development priorities. Delivered by the Government of Australia in close collaboration with the Government of Papua New Guinea, APEP focuses on strengthening economic systems, institutions, and opportunities that support sustainable and inclusive growth through to 2028.
Working alongside government, research institutions, and development partners, APEP delivers coordinated and high‑impact outcomes across four key engagement areas:
Safeguarding Macroeconomic Stability
Supporting More Efficient and Inclusive Markets
Fostering Inclusive Growth and Expanded Livelihoods
Catalysing Economic Research and Dialogue
Gender equality, disability social inclusion (GEDSI), women’s economic empowerment, and climate are central to APEP and integrated across all engagement areas and activities.
Position Overview:
The Senior Program Manager (SPM), Economic Research & Dialogue (ERD) will work closely with APEP teams and externally with PNG partners and research institutions to shape and deliver high‑quality, policy‑relevant research that supports Papua New Guinea’s economic development.
The position will manage the design and implementation of research activities aligned to priority area of economic and social development including macro-economic policy, strengthening a business enabling environment, and agricultural growth in PNG.
Externally, the position will lead the management of key partnerships with Australia National University and the University of Papua New Guinea, as well as with other Australian academic institutions. The role includes working with national research institutions, individual researchers, GoPNG agencies, and other partners to apply a range of approaches which address existing knowledge and data gaps and strengthen research capacity, quality, and take-up in PNG.
The position will be responsible for managing ERD resourcing and supervising the ERD team on a day-to-day basis.
The role offers opportunities for regional engagement, collaboration with leading Australian and national research institutions, and contribution to high-level economic policy dialog. APEP is supportive of professional development and career growth.
Specific Responsibilities:
Manage the ERD team to design and develop research concepts and activities.
Develop and maintain strong and effective stakeholder relationships - includes APEP teams, Australian High Commission, GoPNG agencies, and development partners.
Accurately manage ERD monthly budget forecasting and expenditure.
Manage APEP agreements, partnerships, and subcontracts in accordance with corporate and DFAT policies.
Supervise ERD staff to effectively manage performance, ensure accountability and support skills development as required.
Integrate GEDSI, Women’s Economic Empowerment, Climate and First Nations Australian perspectives into all ERD activities.
Other responsibilities as agreed with the APEP Director.
Selection Criteria:
For applications to be considered,
a response to Selection Criteria below should be provided
.
A degree in a relevant field (i.e., Statistics, Economics, Business Management, and related areas).
Experience developing and implementing development or research strategies, plans and budgets.
Ability to analyse situations, problems, or risks and propose appropriate responses, solutions, and mitigations.
Experience in managing staff resources and performance to deliver expected outputs and outcomes.
Proven experience integrating key cross-cutting themes such as GEDSI, Women’s Economic Empowerment, climate change and First Nations’ perspectives.
Understanding of the research context, environment, and organisations in PNG preferred.
“
We value capability and potential, and welcome applicants who believe they can succeed in this role. If you consider yourself qualified for the position, by meeting most selection criteria, you’re encouraged to apply.”
How to Apply
Please ensure to address the Selection Criteria in your cover letter, and submit your application online, along with your CV as a single document.
Applications must be submitted personally by individuals only. Applications submitted by a company or organisation will not be accepted.
The successful applicant will be engaged through an employment agreement determined by Abt.
We welcome and thank all applications; however, only shortlisted applicants will be contacted
.
Closing Date: Tuesday, 10 March 2026 (Midday, local time)
Abt Global is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to upholding high standards of Child Protection, Anti-bribery and Fraud Protection.
We encourage applications from experienced and capable women, and people with disabilities
Apply

26264.description:
Don’t come for an easy career. Stay for a rewarding one.
Santos is a global energy company committed to increasingly cleaner energy and fuels production, with operations across Australia, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste and North America.
We are currently PNG’s largest single investor and most active explorer, operating all the country’s producing oil fields and holding an extensive appraisal and exploration portfolio. Our aspirations and strategies reflect our genuine commitment to making a meaningful contribution to the lives of Papua New Guineans.
At Santos, our commitment is to be a global leader in the transition to cleaner energy and clean fuels, by helping the world decarbonise to reach net-zero emissions in an affordable and sustainable way.
Santos is one of Australia’s biggest domestic gas supplier, a leading Asia Pacific LNG supplier and is committed to supplying the critical fuels such as oil and gas in a more sustainable way through decarbonising projects such as the Moomba CCS project.
For more than 65 years, Santos has been working in partnership with local communities, providing local jobs and business opportunities, safely and sustainably developing its natural gas resources, and powering industries and households.
What you’ll do:
Based in Port Moresby, the JV Accountant – Oil will prepare Joint Venture billings for operated license areas, including Development Operations and Exploration, manage and coordinate the monthly cash calling process, and perform related analyses to ensure all information complies with Joint Venture Operating Agreements.
Key Responsibilities:
Prepare Joint Venture Billing (JVB) statements for all operated assets
Facilitate and manage the cash call process, including analysis and reconciliation of cash statements
Perform month-end support tasks, including manual cost allocations (Gobe Common WC, KPS Capex, Gobe Main LNG Sharing), PCO calculations, and other ad hoc cost adjustment journals
Track JVB queries and coordinate responses with the Finance Team
Perform General Ledger account reconciliations
Ensure compliance with the Santos Management System (SMS), Delegation of Authority (DOA), and Corporate Governance and Safety requirements
What you’ll bring:
Essential
Bring proven experience in joint venture accounting
Leverage broad experience in accounting within a large organisation
Demonstrated proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word
Manage emails effectively using Microsoft Outlook
Build and maintain strong relationships with Joint Venture partners
Prioritise tasks and manage time efficiently to meet deadlines
Possess a bachelor’s degree in business (Accountancy, Finance, Management, or related discipline
Possess CPA PNG qualification or be actively working towards completion
Experience in SAP Financial Accounting Systems would be ideal
What you’ll get:
Here, you’ll be amongst high-calibre people and get to work on industry-leading projects. We don’t shy away from solving tough problems at pace. We like it that way. You can expect to be challenged and supported; to learn and grow.
At Santos, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. This means a place that is safe; where you are valued and respected, and your contribution is recognised and appreciated. Join us, and you’ll play a role in this too.
Each of our sites offer access to specific amenities that aim to create the best possible benefits to your health, wellbeing and performance.
What you’re part of:
Everywhere you turn you will be a part of a team who are coming together to contribute to our single uniting purpose - to provide reliable and affordable energy to help create a better world for everyone And because it’s not only what you do, but how you do it, you will also contribute to improving the living standards of the communities where we operate, building enduring and respectful relationships that serve a generation. It’s about each of us, and all of us – together.
How to Apply
Applications must be submitted via the online recruitment system before
COB 11 March 2026.
A requirement of this role is that you will need to have in place the legal work rights for PNG to apply
Potential Scams
There are a number of fake adverts that are impersonating Santos Limited, in these instances you will receive an e-mail from a generic e-mail address. We do not make offers without interviews or due diligence taking place. You will know if an advert is genuine if you are directed to the Santos company careers page to apply which is
https://recruitment.santos.com/
Apply

26298.description:
We’re Hiring: Reservations Manager – Port Moresby
Holiday Inn & Suites Port Moresby
Holiday Inn Express Port Moresby
At Holiday Inn, we’re all about making travel easier and more enjoyable for our guests — and that starts with the people who bring our brand to life. If you’re a relationship-builder, a natural connector, and someone who loves driving commercial results while keeping things genuine and human, we’d love to meet you.
The Opportunity
The Reservations Manager is responsible for leading the reservations function across Holiday Inn Express Port Moresby and Holiday Inn & Suites Port Moresby. This role is a key position within the Commercial Team and plays a critical part in driving rooms revenue through effective reservations management, conversion and reconversion, rate integrity, distribution performance, and strong collaboration with Sales and Revenue. The role supports both Transient and Group business, ensuring enquiry handling, quoting, follow-up, and booking conversion is completed to a high standard, in line with IHG brand standards and property commercial priorities.
What You’ll Do
Lead, coach and develop the reservations team to deliver high performance and strong guest service.
Set daily priorities, manage workload, and ensure coverage across both hotels.
Maintain clear standards for response times, quoting quality, follow-up, and booking conversion.
Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and ongoing performance management.
Maximize conversion of all reservation enquiries across direct, indirect and group channels.
Drive reconversion activity (lost business recovery) for both transient and group enquiries.
Monitor booking pace and support the Revenue team with demand trends and pickup insights.
Ensure accurate reservation input, correct segmentation, and strong data quality.
Support the Sales team with group quoting, rate loading, room blocks, cut-off dates, and group pick-up tracking.
Ensure group enquiries are actioned quickly and professionally, with strong follow-up.
Coordinate with Conference & Events teams where required to ensure room blocks align with event requirements.
Ensure rate parity, correct rate loading, and compliance with pricing strategies set by Revenue.
Support distribution health across channels (IHG.com, OTAs, GDS, corporate rates, travel agents).
Identify rate issues, mapping errors, or channel problems and escalate for correction.
Work closely with the Revenue Manager and the Portfolio Director of Sales and Marketing to support MPI/ARI strategy and daily pricing execution.
Partner with Sales on account production, contracting support, and booking optimization.
Work closely with Front Office to support arrival management, rooming lists, and forecasting.
Coordinate with Finance on billing requirements, credit checks, and group payment terms.
Produce and maintain weekly/monthly reporting including conversion, reconversion, enquiry response times, and group pick-up.
Maintain clear documentation and standard operating procedures for the Reservations function.
Ensure reservations handling meets IHG standards and supports a positive guest experience.
Maintain professional and consistent communication across all channels (email, phone, portals).
Support guest issue resolution related to reservations and booking discrepancies.
What we need from you
3–5 years’ experience in hotel reservations (international brand preferred).
Proven experience leading a reservations team and driving conversion performance.
Strong understanding of transient, group and long-stay booking processes.
Experience supporting Revenue Management strategies (MPI, ARI, RevPAR and rate integrity).
Strong knowledge of distribution channels (IHG.com, OTAs, GDS, travel agents and corporate negotiated rates).
High attention to detail with strong reporting, forecasting and administration skills.
Good understanding of Port Moresby market dynamics, including mining and FIFO travel patterns.
Join us today!
In return for your hard work, you can look forward to a highly competitive salary and benefits package. What’s more, because your career will be as unique as you are, we’ll give you all the tailored support you need to make a great start, be involved and grow.
And because the Holiday Inn & Suites Port Moresby brand belongs to the IHG® family of brands, you’ll also benefit from all of the opportunities that come from being part of a successful, global hospitality company with over 6000 hotels in over 100 countries around the world.
So, whoever you are, whatever you love doing, bring your passion to Holiday Inn and IHG and we’ll make sure you’ll have room to be yourself.
Hand deliver your application or email
[email protected]
Closing date, Monday 09
th
March 2026.
Applications must be addressed to;
Human Resources Team
Holiday Inn & Suites Port Moresby
P.O. BOX 1981 Boroko, NCD

26297.description:
COURTESY BUS DRIVER
We are looking for an individual who is welcoming and smart; someone who can focus on the things that really matter to our guests and get them right every time. Join us as a
Courtesy Bus Driver
. You will have ambition, talent and obviously, some key skills.
A little insight of your day-to-day
Responsible for safe transfer of guests from hotel to airport
Create guest satisfaction through a pleasing personality, effective communication skills and should be first to greet the guest as per time of the day
Maintain good knowledge of the city routes locations and hotel facilities
Maintain knowledge of flight timings and assist guest in handling and loading baggage whenever required
Maintain a high standard of personal hygiene and be well groomed and well dressed at all times
Do utmost to learn names of guests, especially repeat and long staying guests remaining alert to situations to offer assistance
Maintain detailed knowledge of facilities and services of the hotel and use this knowledge to promote the hotel to guests
Keep abreast of activities in your city which may affect driving times or routes and relay this to management
Responsible for the upkeep and cleanliness of the car used for guest transfer and assist with maintaining vehicles to hotel presentation standards
Performs other duties as may be assigned by the Rooms Division Manager
What we need from you
3-5 years Driving experience.
Current Police Clearance.
Must have valid class 6 Drivers License.
Can effectively manage time to meet deadlines and work well under pressure
High attention to details with the ability to work unsupervised
Report to work as rostered
Always maintain a neat and tidy appearance
Maintain honesty and integrity in all dealings
